videos.title: How LV Lost Millions by Winning a Trademark Dispute in China
videos.description: Louis Vuitton is facing a growing backlash in China after its trademark dispute with local tea chain Molly Tea sparked a wave of social media criticism. The controversy's adding pressure on LVMH, which is already dealing with a broader slowdown in China, one of its biggest markets. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Microsoft Plans Data Center Push to Triple Its Computing Power
